Sound familiar?

You've lost it before. You know what happens next.

You've done the diets. Maybe the shots too. The weight came off, and then life happened. A stressful month, a few bad nights of sleep, the holidays. And it found its way back, usually with a few extra pounds.

After 40 it got harder. Your body stopped responding the way it used to, and every attempt left you a little more tired and a little less sure it would work for you.

If that's you, we built this for you.

It was never a willpower problem.

A GLP-1 treats appetite. A diet treats calories. But weight after 40 is tied to your metabolism, your hormones, inflammation, and how you handle stress, all at once. Miss one and the others pull you back.

The metabolic difference

GLP-1s can take your muscle. We help you keep it.

In GLP-1 trials, up to 40% of the weight lost was lean mass, which includes muscle. Muscle is what keeps your metabolism working for you. Lose it, and your body burns less at rest, so when the medication stops, the weight comes back more easily. We protect your muscle so your metabolism keeps protecting you.

About us

Built by a husband and wife. Called to this work.

Soul Body Mind Fit is a co-creation of Colin F. Watson and his wife, JJ Watson.

Colin knows this road from the inside. After years of corporate burnout and diets that never held, he was 50 pounds overweight, diabetic, and depressed. Releasing that weight renewed more than his body. It renewed his mind and his faith. For the 17 years since, he has coached people through the same turn, most of them women over 40.

JJ, a longtime certified personal trainer and group exercise instructor, coaches alongside him, and she found the missing key. She saw what the scale couldn't show: the weight stays off when you learn to regulate your emotions and handle stress, old habits, and hard days without food taking over.

Emotional regulation is JJ's superpower. She shares it with every woman they coach, so each woman's results stay in her own hands, not in a lifetime of medication.

Together they shaped what they learned into the Soul Body Mind Fit Method, the approach behind this program and their book, Stop Losing Weight, Release It.

Their team is made up of women who have done this themselves. Each coach once stood where you're standing, released the weight, and kept it off. Now they show up in service to other women, paying forward what was given to them.

Our story

  1. 2009: Where it began

    Colin is type 2 diabetic, with severe sleep apnea, high blood pressure, and a 46-inch waist. He releases the weight with the help of peptides and renews his body, mind, and faith.

  2. 2010: JJ joins

    JJ changes her own life too, learns firsthand what keeps the weight off, and she and Colin team up.

  3. 2010 to 2017: On the air

    Colin hosts a live radio show and podcast on YouTube, coaching callers live, reaching more than 500,000 views and listeners.

  4. 2011: Changing lives together

    Colin and JJ start coaching women side by side.

  5. Breakdowns and breakthroughs

    Three books and thousands of transformations later, every setback and every win has shaped the peptides, protocols, and coaching into a method built for women over 40.

  6. 2026 and beyond

    We've impacted the lives of thousands, with a team of women paying it forward. And we're committed to you, and to every woman still to come.

    Terms and important information

    Results

    GLP-1 comparisons

    GLP-1 figures come from published clinical trials of semaglutide (STEP 1, its one-year extension, and STEP 4) and a body composition substudy of tirzepatide (SURMOUNT-1). Those trials enrolled different people under different conditions than this program. The comparison is a general reference, not a head-to-head study, and does not predict how any medication will work for you. Soul Body Mind Fit is not affiliated with or endorsed by Novo Nordisk or Eli Lilly. Ozempic, Wegovy, and Zepbound are trademarks of their respective owners.

    Medical

    This quiz is for information only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and it does not create a provider-patient relationship. Any peptide or medication is prescribed only by a licensed healthcare provider after an individual evaluation, and only if it is clinically appropriate for you. Some peptides are compounded medications, which are not FDA-approved and have not been reviewed by the FDA for safety, effectiveness, or quality. Some medications, including HCG, may be prescribed off-label, meaning for a use the FDA has not approved. HCG is not FDA-approved for weight loss. Do not start, stop, or change any medication, including a GLP-1, without talking to your prescribing provider. Talk to your doctor before starting any nutrition or exercise program. If you have a medical emergency, call 911.

    Coaching

    Coaching, including mindset and emotional regulation coaching, is not medical care or mental health treatment. It is not therapy and does not replace care from a licensed mental health professional.

    AI assistant

    The question-and-answer assistant is an AI, not a person or a licensed provider. Its answers are general information, may contain mistakes, and are not medical advice. Questions about your health, medications, or eligibility are answered by a licensed provider during your evaluation.

    Your information

    We use the details you share, including questions you ask the assistant, to send your results and contact you about the program. Consent to receive texts is not a condition of purchase. You can opt out at any time.

    Frequently asked questions

    Who is this for?

    Women 40+ who have lost weight before and want to keep it off this time, including women who have used, or are using, a GLP-1. We also have a separate men's program.

    How is this different from getting a GLP-1 prescription?

    A prescription treats appetite. We start with your labs, and licensed providers through KIS Rx prescribe personalized peptides and supplements only when they're right for you. Then we add what a prescription doesn't: a plan to protect your muscle, one-on-one coaching for stress and emotional eating, and a small pod that keeps you on track.

    How fast will I see results?

    The typical client who stayed with the program released 12.7 lbs in the first 28 days and about 15% of their body weight by day 120. On semaglutide alone, the first month usually brings about 2 to 5 lbs while the dose is still low. These are medians for clients who kept logging; individual results vary.

    Will I keep it off?

    That's what the program is built for. Clients we followed for a year or more kept about 80% of the weight they released, about two years later. After stopping semaglutide, people in its main trial kept about a third.

    Do I have to stay on peptides or medication?

    Medication can quiet your appetite, but it can't teach you what to do when you're stressed, tired, or celebrating. The goal is for the plan to live in you, not in a prescription. Emotional regulation and the habits you build are skills you keep. Your provider decides if and when any medication is tapered, and please don't stop or change a medication without talking to your prescriber.

    Will I lose muscle?

    We plan to protect it with protein targets, strength training for women 40+, and body composition tracking. In GLP-1 trials, 26 to 40% of weight lost was lean mass. In the early body scans from our clients, it was about 14%, from a small group of 17, so we're measuring more.

    What are personalized peptides?

    Peptides are short chains of amino acids that act as signals in the body. Some, like GLP-1 medications, are prescription drugs. After reviewing your labs, history, and goals, a licensed provider decides whether any peptides or supplements are right for you, which ones, and for how long, then adjusts as your numbers change. Some are compounded medications, which are not FDA-approved. Your provider explains the benefits and risks before anything is prescribed.

    What is emotional regulation coaching?

    It's how you learn to handle stress, boredom, fatigue, and celebrations without food running the show. Your coach works with you one-on-one to notice what's driving the urge, pause, and choose on purpose. It's coaching, not therapy, and it doesn't replace care from a licensed mental health professional.

    What's a pod?

    A small group of women going through the program with you. You check in together, notice when someone goes quiet, and help each other get back on track, with your coach alongside.

    How do you track my progress?

    Labs at the start and along the way, plus body composition and measurements. Your dashboard shows scores for areas like metabolic health, inflammation, hormones, and nutrients, and your provider, your coach, and you all look at the same numbers.

    Who are the providers?

    Licensed providers through our telemedicine partner, KIS Rx, handle your labs, consults, prescriptions, and shipping. Coaching, food, training, and your pod are run by our team.

    I'm already on a GLP-1. Can I join?

    Yes. A licensed provider reviews your current treatment as part of your plan. Please don't stop or change any medication without talking to your prescriber.

    Do you use HCG?

    Some clients are prescribed HCG as part of their plan when a licensed provider decides it's appropriate. It's prescribed off-label, which means HCG is not FDA-approved for weight loss. Your provider reviews your labs and explains the benefits and risks before anything is prescribed.

    What happens on the free call?

    We walk through your quiz results and your goals, answer your questions, and lay out your options. You'll leave with your personal Muscle Protection Plan, yours to keep whether or not you join.

    What does it cost?

    There are three ways in. A live group session is free. Know your numbers is $300 one time, for blood work, a personalized peptide stack recommendation from a licensed provider through KIS Rx, and a 30-minute 1:1 coaching session with Coach Colin. New You: The 120-Day Solution is $2,500 per month with everything included: your custom program, blood work, full peptide stack and supplements, meal plans, weekly 1:1 coaching with Colin and JJ, weekly pods, tracking, and your dashboard. Financing is available through Klarna, and it comes with our guarantee: if you don't release 15 lbs in your first 30 days, you don't pay. For a fully private program customized completely for you, VIP is $10,000 per month.

    Do I need insurance, and is my information private?

    No insurance is needed. Your health information is handled with HIPAA safeguards and encrypted connections.
